content:
Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal, pre-orders are flying on the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 with some early discounts. We just detailed how to score the new AirPods 5 from just $64 at up to 50% off (right here) and Amazon just delivered the first pre-order discount on the luxurious new Ceramic Apple Watch Series 12. We also have a sizable discount on this Studio Display XDR model at $330 off, the return of all-time low pricing on AirTag from $20 each, and a solid $50 off Sharge’s impressive metal 300W smart display power bank. Check it all out below.

AirPods 5 pre-orders now live, but flagship AirPods Pro 3 only $50 more right now

Apple has now unleashed its new AirPods 5 with pre-orders now live on the base set at $129 and the higher-end Wireless Charging Case model at $149. Thing is, you can score the flagship AirPods Pro 3 for just $50 more than that right now with the ongoing Amazon deal.

Here’s how pricing works out across the lineup now:

  • AirPods 5 $129
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case $149
  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

Score new AirPods 5 for just $64 with Best Buy’s enhanced trade-ins (Up to 50% off)

Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on Apple’s flagship AirPods Pro 3, pre-orders are now live on the brand new AirPods 5 and higher-end AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. Thus far we are yet to see any notable cash discounts, and Apple does not appear to be offering any trade-in options for the series 5 AirPods, but Best Buy is and you can knock up to 50% off when you flip your AirPods 4 for the new set.

Here’s how pricing shakes out as of right now across the current-generation AirPods:

  • AirPods 5 $129

As you can see, the new AirPods 5 start at $129, this time with Active Noise Cancellation tech included, but if you want the on-stem touch controls and a wireless charging case you’ll need to drop $149. That is, however, only $50 less than the deal pricing on the higher-end AirPods Pro 3 right now – $50 is not insignificant, but it is very much something to keep in mind.

That said, if you are looking to score the AirPods 5, you can bring the price down by trading in your AirPods 4 for the new set at Best Buy:

You can land the new AirPods 5 for as low as $64.

Best Buy will give you $50 for the base AirPods 4 and $65 back for the AirPods 4 with ANC. That brings the base AirPods 5 (that include ANC this year) down to as low as $64 and the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case down to as low as $84. These are the best prices/deals we have tracked for the new Apple buds yet.

Amazon already starting to drop the price on Apple Watch Series 12 pre-orders

Pre-orders for the new AirPods 5 are now live from $129, and Amazon is already starting to undercut everyone on the Series 12. While we aren’t talking about massive deals here, Amazon is now offering select Series 12 models for less than everyone else.

As you can see with this 42mm Series 12 GPS + Cell configuration, Amazon has it listed down at $489.99 shipped.

Again, this is not a huge deal – we get it, but every penny counts around here and we just wanted to make sure folks were in the know.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cell $490 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cell $549
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $699
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $749
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic $949

Apple Watch Series 12 or Ultra 4 pre-order deals: Up to $325 off via Best Buy enhanced trade

All-time low pricing returns on AirTag 2 today at $20 each

Pre-orders are flying on the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 (Amazon already has some deals too), but the AirTag 2 deals are back again today as well. After jumping back up close to full price over the last couple days, Amazon has decided to bring back all-time low pricing on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 at $20 each.

The single AirTag 2 listing has remained down at $24 Prime shipped for a few weeks now – this is matching the lowest price we have tracked for one of them in new condition at Amazon.

The 4-pack, however, is now sitting back down at $79.99 shipped– that’s $20 per AirTag 2.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Apple’s 2026 Studio Display XDR just dropped back to best price ever at $330 off (Or $500 off refurb)

Pre-orders are now live on AirPods 5 and we have some discounts on the new M6 Mac mini lineup ahead of delivery this month, but we are also tracking some solid price drops on Apple’s latest 2026 Studio Displays as well. The most affordable model you can buy is still at $100 off, and Amazon just brought back the all-time low on this Studio Display XDR model at $330 off.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR with the sweet Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand down at $2,969 shipped.

Easily one of the most gorgeous displays you can add to your workstation, home studio, or editing bay, this model carries a $3,299 list price and is now a solid $330 off.

Just remember, this same model from the official Apple Refurb Store right now down at $2,799 shipped. That’s $500 off the list and a seriously great price for this thing.

Sharge’s metal 300W smart display power bank returns to all-time low at $50 off

I recently had a chance to test out the latest Sharge 300W Power Bank, complete with a 24000mAh internal battery, customizable RBG, and sweet window cutouts in the solid metal housing. It is very impressive, and you can now land one back down at the lowest price we have tracked at $50 off via Amazon.

The official Sharge Amazon storefront is now offering its latest Shargeek 300W Power Bank down at $179 shipped after clipping the on-page coupon.

This is a gorgeous, built-like-a-tank power bank solution that carries a $229 list price. Today’s deal knocks $50 off to bring back the lowest price we have tracked to date. There was a short early launch offer at this same rate, but it jumped back up to $199 thereafter.

My hands-on review provides plenty of detail if you want to take a closer look.

  • Complete the Burgundy iPhone 18 Pro look with Baseus’ new 25W Qi2.2 MagSafe power bank at $66 [Launch Deal]

Giant $500 price drop hits Apple’s 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at Amazon today

Okay, it’s back folks – Amazon is once again offering a major $500 price drop on Apple’s latest 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro ahead of today’s iPhone event.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity down at $2,699 shipped.

Regularly $3,199, this is a straight $500 price drop and the best deal we can find.

While many of the deals we have been tracking on the latest MacBook lineup since the price hike have just been bringing the machine back to the former MSRP, that’s not the case here. This deal is actually $100 less than the previous list price on this machine.

You’re also looking at the more future-proof 2TB model here with the upgraded 18-Core CPU and 20-Core GPU.
